# Crunchbase and Intel Cut 124 Bay Area Tech Jobs as Layoff Wave Continues


By OpenTools Team


·


November 20, 2026


Crunchbase filed to cut 67 positions from its San Francisco headquarters, including senior engineers and a VP of finance. Intel axed 57 jobs across Santa Clara County while launching a global IT layoff round. Both filings land as Bay Area tech layoffs pile up, with 206,877 cuts across the industry so far in 2026.


## The Numbers: 124 Jobs in One Week


Two more Bay Area tech companies filed layoff notices this week. Crunchbase is cutting **67 positions** at its San Francisco headquarters.[Intel](https://opentools.ai/organizations/intel) is dropping **57 jobs** across four Santa Clara County locations. That is 124 roles between them, and the real Intel number is likely higher because its global IT organization cuts have not been disclosed, according to[the San Francisco Chronicle](https://www.sfchronicle.com/tech/article/crunchbase-intel-tech-layoffs-22540532.php) . Both filings appeared in California WARN notices — not rumors, not whispers, but legal paperwork.


## Crunchbase Cuts Deep Into Senior Ranks


Crunchbase filed its WARN notice for 67 layoffs at its Market Street headquarters, effective **January 17** . The list does not look like entry-level trimming. Per[the Chronicle](https://www.sfchronicle.com/tech/article/crunchbase-intel-tech-layoffs-22540532.php) , the cuts include the vice president of finance, several senior engineering positions, a senior sales manager, senior data analysts, and a senior content marketing manager. This is not cutting from the bottom — it is reducing middle and upper management.


Crunchbase operates a database and business-intelligence platform that tracks startups and private companies. Its customers are sales teams, investors, and market analysts — the same groups feeling pressure across the tech sector. The company has not commented publicly on the rationale behind the cuts.


## Intel: 57 Local Cuts, Global IT Layoffs Unfolding


[Intel](https://opentools.ai/organizations/intel) filed to cut 57 jobs across four Santa Clara County locations, effective November 15. But that filing only covers what California law requires Intel to report. The company also began a new round of global IT organization layoffs this week, and it has not disclosed how many workers are affected,[the Chronicle](https://www.sfchronicle.com/tech/article/crunchbase-intel-tech-layoffs-22540532.php) reported.[Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/intel-layoffs-restructuring-ceo-lip-bu-tan-2026-11) confirmed that employees posted on social media about being affected by the IT cuts.


An Intel spokesperson told[Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/intel-layoffs-restructuring-ceo-lip-bu-tan-2026-11) the company "continually assess\[es\] our workforce to ensure priorities and resources are appropriately aligned." This language has accompanied nearly every Intel layoff since CEO Lip-Bu Tan took over.


## Intel's 27,800-Person Shrinkage


The 57 Santa Clara cuts are a fraction of a much larger story.[Intel](https://opentools.ai/organizations/intel) ended 2024 with roughly **108,900 employees** , according to[Calcalistech](https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/8nyi8xs6n) . By September 2026, that number had dropped to **81,100** . That is roughly 27,800 positions eliminated in under two years — a 25% workforce reduction.


[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/intel-hits-organization-another-round-192903059.html) reported that the global IT layoffs could affect between 260 and 520 of the unit's 2,607 employees. Meanwhile,[Nvidia](https://opentools.ai/organizations/nvidia) reduced its Intel stock holdings by 25% during Q3 2026, cutting its position from roughly 214.8 million shares to 161.1 million,[Calcalistech](https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/8nyi8xs6n) noted.


## The Bay Area Layoff Wave Keeps Rolling


Crunchbase and[Intel](https://opentools.ai/organizations/intel) are not anomalies.[The Chronicle](https://www.sfchronicle.com/tech/article/crunchbase-intel-tech-layoffs-22540532.php) noted that these cuts follow layoffs at eBay, Netflix, and Qualcomm, which announced plans this week to eliminate 75 positions in the region. The Bay Area's tech job market is contracting in repeated pulses rather than a single crash.


Nationally, the numbers are staggering. According to TrueUp's tracker, **206,877 people** have been laid off at tech companies so far in 2026, across **715 layoff events** ,[Crunchbase News](https://news.crunchbase.com/startups/tech-layoffs/) reported. The Financial Times separately reported that US tech firms had shed roughly 140,000 jobs by earlier in the year, with about 50,000 cuts concentrated at[Amazon](https://opentools.ai/organizations/amazon) , Oracle, Meta, and[Microsoft](https://opentools.ai/organizations/microsoft) .


## What Builders Should Watch


Two patterns matter for builders. First, **senior roles are not safe** . Crunchbase cut a VP of finance and multiple senior individual contributors.[Intel](https://opentools.ai/organizations/intel) is going after IT infrastructure — the people who keep internal systems running. If you are building tools that sell into data platforms or enterprise hardware, your customer base is shrinking and the buyers who remain have different priorities. Budget scrutiny is the default setting now.


Second, **headcount tells the real story** . Intel's 25% workforce reduction over two years says more about the company's trajectory than any quarterly earnings slide. When[Nvidia](https://opentools.ai/organizations/nvidia) cuts its stake by a quarter and the CEO is running a continuous restructuring, the signal is clear: this is not a one-time correction. It is a structural shift.
